scenes.text: A chatbot answers one question. [1] An agent gets a goal, and works on it by itself, step after step. [2] Today, A I agents.

An A I agent is an L L M, plus tools, running in a loop. [1] It plans the next step, uses a tool, looks at the result, and repeats, until the goal is done. [2] It plans. [3] It uses tools. [4] It checks its own results.

data.definition: An LLM with tools, running in a loop until the goal is done.

scenes.text: Let's give an agent a goal. Plan a weekend trip to Goa, under fifteen thousand rupees. [1] It loops. Plan, act, observe. [2] It searches for trains. [3] It checks hotel prices. [4] It adds it up. Over budget, so it swaps the hotel. [5] And it returns a full plan, under budget.
Chatbot versus agent. [1] A chatbot gives you information, and you do the work. [2] An agent does the work, across many steps and tools, and reports back.

Agents are already here. [1] Coding agents that write, test and fix code across a whole project. [2] Research agents that read dozens of pages, and write a report. [3] And customer service agents that can actually process your refund.
Myth! [1] Agents are fully autonomous. Just let them run. [2] Careful. Mistakes can snowball over many steps. Good agents check with a human before important actions, like payments.

data.myth: Agents are fully autonomous. Just let them run.
data.fact: Mistakes can snowball across steps. Good agents check with a human before important actions.

scenes.text: Quick quiz! What makes something an agent, and not just a chatbot? [1] Pause and think. <pause 3.2> [2] It works in a loop, using tools, toward a goal! Comment loop if you got it!

Recap. [1] An agent is an L L M, with tools, in a loop. [2] Plan, act, observe, repeat. [3] It does multi step work for you. [4] With a human approving the big actions. [5] Next episode, M C P. The universal connector for A I tools. Follow A I Maastaaru!
